message: Forecasting model 'neural-forecaster-bilstm' training aborted: Insufficient longitudinal observation depth.

audit.decision_rationale: Incident dataset spans 5.7 hours (0.24 days). Minimum requirement for daily forecasting is 30 continuous periods. The current operational dataset reflects a single 5.8-hour observation window on 2026-11-07. Training recurrent neural networks (BiLSTM) or ARIMA on single-day records produces severe hallucination without genuine temporal autocorrelation.
audit.prohibition_policy: CivicPulse AI strictly prohibits publishing forecast predictions or training ML models on synthetic seed demo records. Autonomous maintenance dispatch based on ungrounded forecasting is strictly prohibited.
